latest.notes: Scheduler: cross-day hour churn (vertical rotation). Log generation now avoids parking a music track in the same clock hour day after day — it looks at where each song aired in the last few days and where it's already scheduled in the coming days (a 3-day window each side) and steers it to a different hour. Sweepers/jingles/IDs stay positional. The rule relaxes if a small rotation leaves no alternative, so slots always fill.
